correctness.rationale: Equal areas force equality in the planar Brunn--Minkowski inequality for the midpoint set. Its equality characterization makes the outer slices translates, and equal-area inclusion identifies the middle slice with their midpoint translate. After an explicit affine shear, all three slices are the same convex body. Every non-horizontal halfspace containing the middle centroid has a middle planar section containing that centroid and one nested outer section containing the middle section. The planar Grünbaum--Winternitz theorem gives at least \(4a/9\) on each of those two slices, hence at least \(8a/9=(8/27)\mu(S)\). Horizontal halfspaces contain at least two full slices. All quantifiers and degenerate orientation cases are covered.
